title: application-code-get-detail-dto
description: Immutable DTO representing a detailed Application Code.

isFeeDue.description: True if Application List Entries using this Application Code require an Application List Entry Fee Status to be created and linked.

requiresRespondent.description: True if Application List Entries using this Application Code require a respondent to be created and linked.

bulkRespondentAllowed.description: True if Application List Entries using this Application Code allow multiple respondents to be created and linked.

feeReference.description: A short reference code that identifies a Fee.

offsiteFeeReference.description: A short reference code that identifies a offsite Fee.

offsiteFeeDescription.description: Descriptive text for the offsite fee.

startDate.description: Date the Application Code became active.

endDate.description: Date the Application Code became inactive. `null` indicates that this row is still active.

application_code_get_detail_dto_feeAmoun.description: Fee amount for this Application Code, expressed in pence (GBP minor units). Always use integer values; 1 GBP = 100 pence.

application_code_get_detail_dto_offsiteF.description: Offsite Fee amount for this Application Code, expressed in pence (GBP minor units). Always use integer values; 1 GBP = 100 pence.

template-constraint.description: The template field with an associated value

type.description: The data type of the value.

length.description: The length of the data value.

template.description: The template name. It contains the field names between curly braces.

substitution-key-constraints.description: A list of fields and the associated constraints

template-key-with-constraint.description: The template field with an associated value

key.description: Field key for substitution into the template.

value.description: The optional value for the key.

constraint.description: The constraint details for the field
